en.title: The Locked Room of the Scarlet Cherry Blossoms
en.premise: As the rare 'Scarlet Cherry Blossoms' blooming on the cliffs reach their peak, a guest invited to the island is found dead at the top of an abandoned lighthouse—a perfect locked room. Beside the body lie withered cherry blossom petals, out of season. From the minute inconsistencies left at the scene, the brilliant detective Kagurazaka unravels the cruel logic hidden behind this impossible crime.

zh.title: 绯樱密室
zh.premise: 当悬崖峭壁上稀有的“绯樱”迎来盛开之时，受邀来到岛上的宾客之一，被发现死于一座完全密闭的废弃灯塔顶端。尸体旁散落着些许不合时节的“枯萎樱花瓣”。名侦探神乐坂从现场留下的细微违和感中，推导出了隐藏在不可能犯罪背后的残酷逻辑。
